calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, invert its five-trading-day return relative to the same-day cross-sectional median return. Positive values identify recent relative underperformers, targeting short-horizon mean reversion while removing common market movement. Signal uses data through t to predict return at t+1.

validation.method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman rank correlation between t signal and t+1 close-to-close return; observations require at least 8 valid instruments. Results are pooled across historical dates, not fabricated from a single cross-section.
validation.regime_notes: Positive in both early and late sample halves: IC 0.07061 early and 0.03212 late; late-sample attenuation warrants monitoring. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
